name: Hazama
source: The action takes place during the Shouwa era. A boy named Inada Shuuya has disappeared without a trace, and his youkai friend—Nagisa Youan—must reveal himself and rescue him. And, of course, get along with some girls along the way.
translation: 故事发生在昭和时代。一个名叫稻田修也的男孩消失得无影无踪，他的妖怪朋友——渚渊安——必须现身并营救他。当然，一路上还要和一些女孩相处。
